name: Cragpool Lake
summary: In Windshear Crag, the Venture Company’s timberworks hang above Cragpool Lake and its dark water.

sections.title: Industrial Encroachment
sections.body: At Cragpool Lake, Venture Company platforms cross above the water beneath a vast timber structure. Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle watches operations across the mountain valley. Company workers occupy the platforms overhead.

faq.q: What is the massive wooden structure hanging over the lake?
faq.answer: The Venture Company built a vast wooden structure over Cragpool Lake to manage its logging and mining in Windshear Crag. Platforms and heavy machinery span the water.

faq.q: Who oversees the operations at Cragpool Lake?
faq.answer: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle oversees operations at Cragpool Lake. From the high scaffolding, the Venture Company operative watches deforestation and resource extraction across Windshear Crag.
Venture Company workers operate on the platforms above Cragpool Lake. Their armed presence makes the site dangerous for intruders.

faq.q: Has the Venture Company abandoned Cragpool Lake?
faq.answer: No. Venture Company workers and Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle occupy the structure above Cragpool Lake.

angles.text: The timber scaffolding and cantilevered machinery above Cragpool Lake show goblin industry built quickly and heavily, with little regard for the land beneath it.
As a druid, you see the runoff, timber platforms, and disruption around Cragpool Lake as a scar on Stonetalon. They warp the local ecosystem and displace native wildlife.
